texts.text: In this paper, we develop a modified nonlinear DD finite element method for the convection-diffusion-reaction model (1.1), give results of existence and uniqueness for discrete solution, and derive a priori error estimates. Compared with [56], our main contributions lie in the following aspects:

texts.label: list_item
texts.orig: · The considered model (1.1) is more general where the velocity β is not necessarily divergence free and the reaction coefficient σ is a function, while in [56] it has been assumed that ∇· β = 0 and σ is a constant;
texts.text: The considered model (1.1) is more general where the velocity β is not necessarily divergence free and the reaction coefficient σ is a function, while in [56] it has been assumed that ∇· β = 0 and σ is a constant;

texts.label: list_item
texts.orig: · We modify the artificial diffusivity term to a proper dimensional scale, thus unify the two alternative variants of the artificial diffusion in [56] into one form. In the proof of the existence of approximation solutions, we do not assume the boundedness of the maximum norm of the gradient of functions in approximation space (see Remark 4.1). We further prove the uniqueness of approximation solution for the modified DD method under an assumption on small mesh size.

texts.orig: This paper is organized as follows. Section 2 gives notations and weak formulations of the model problem. Section 3 presents the modified DD scheme. Section 4 proves the existence and uniqueness of discrete solutions for the modified DD method, and also contains some preliminary results at the beginning of this section. Section 5 analyzes the optimal convergence order for the modified DD method. Finally, section 6 provides some numerical tests to support our theoretical results.

Section 5 analyzes the optimal convergence order for the modified DD method. Finally, section 6 provides some numerical tests to support our theoretical results.
